verdict.rationale: Rev AI is an API-first product with first-party docs for an Asynchronous Speech-to-Text API and a Streaming API (WebSocket and RTMP), plus webhooks for job completion and SDKs with code samples. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This tutorial uses the Asynchronous Speech to Text API to produce a transcript of an audio file submitted by you.
There are two ways to interact with the Streaming Speech-to-Text API: WebSocket protocol, RTMP streams
use webhooks to asynchronously receive notifications once the transcription job completes.
Integrate faster with SDKs and code samples.
